term: International Conference on Computational Intelligence Methods for Bioinformatics and Biostatistics
definition: The International Conference on Computational Intelligence Methods for Bioinformatics and Biostatistics (CIBB) is an annual scientific conference focused on machine learning and computational intelligence methods applied to bioinformatics, biostatistics, and medical informatics.
